recipe.ghg_method: No environmental accounts are supplied with this local FIGARO IOT reading.
recipe.gdp_basis: Value added at basic prices plus net product taxes on intermediate and final uses
recipe.gdp_note: D1 + D29X39 + B2A3G plus D21X31 on intermediate and final uses. Country totals independently reconciled to source rows; residence-purchase adjustments are excluded from the income calculation. FIGARO compilation uses national-accounts aggregates and World Bank world GDP; this comparison is not an independent accuracy test.
recipe.value_added_note: Sum of the explicitly listed value-added rows in the source; product taxes and balancing adjustments are excluded.
recipe.attribution: Source: Eurostat, FIGARO, naio_10_fcp_ip2, 2014. Calculations by MARIO; Eurostat is not responsible for the derived results.

provenance.reading_scope: Full MARIO IOT parse using the supplied cache only; independently reconciled VA and D21X31 by country, calc_all=False.
provenance.data_refresh_reason: Supplied local source cache differs from the previous numeric vintage; income factors and final-use taxes independently reconciled.
